subject.title: Slack: Show tool-level progress in assistant thread status

question: Should Slack native assistant thread status show sanitized per-tool progress, or remain generic while existing Slack loading messages, preview progress, task cards, and optional reactions carry progress visibility?
rationale: The source-level gap is clear, but exposing active tool context in Slack status intersects user-visible duplication, disclosure safety, default behavior, and possible config policy.

options.title: Defer Behind Visibility Policy
options.body: Keep this issue open and decide it together with the Slack-safe progress visibility policy before adding native per-tool status labels.

options.title: Implement Sanitized Native Status
options.body: Add deduped per-tool `assistant.threads.setStatus` updates from the shared sanitized progress model, with clear behavior, tests, and live Slack proof.

options.title: Keep Native Status Generic
options.body: Document that native Slack assistant status stays generic and progress should use loading messages, preview progress, task cards, or reactions instead.

recommendation.title: Defer Behind Visibility Policy
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and decide it together with the Slack-safe progress visibility policy before adding native per-tool status labels.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the clearest recent owner for the Slack native-status default and adjacent docs/tests surface.
